desc: How a rigged Boki's walk, carry and run clips play (BokiRig). Rate = move speed / (stride x its world scale), between min_rate and max_cadence step cycles/s; it gallops from run_from: just past (walk_past x) the speed where its walk reaches max_cadence, kept in the run_from range. stride: m/s a planted foot moves back at rate 1 and scale 1, [walk, run], measured by --boki-anim-audit; a Boki with no stepping feet (flyers, serpents, blobs) has no row and keeps default.
